value.rationale: The rank-one scalar-deviation locus is intrinsically defined by the quotient scalar a and the derived ideal V, not by an arbitrary coordinate cut. It is the first nontrivial determinantal neighborhood of scalar operators, on an unbounded natural non-Lie Leibniz family. The rank-d coefficient detects rational eigenlines of arbitrary module action, and a second exact shifted-Jordan stratum detects noneigenline incidence. Complete branch classification and exact finite-field rank polynomial address an independently motivated structural invariant.
